cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the national ID card or number is issued beyond pilot communes, or that the system checks people by biometrics.
cells.note: Stage 2: ONIP's biometric card has been issued only in pilot Kinshasa communes since 2024, mass enrolment had not reached the provinces by September 2026, and RDC-PASS is in its first operational phase. The 2024 description of the population file does not show cards or numbers issued to each person, so stage 3 is not met.
